cause_quote: The original sidebar used `if (!output || output.outputText === undefined)` to mark an image-only match unavailable and showed text export controls whenever loading had finished.
user_saw: Opening a successful image-only tool result showed “Full output unavailable” and offered copy and download controls with no text to export.
summary: The tool details sidebar now accepts matched, complete image-only results and shows text export controls only when there is text to export.
reasoning: I checked that the parent of #153542 already supported image-only MCP results. The original recovery sidebar added in #153542 treated missing text as missing output even for a completed match, and the later Solid refactors carried that check forward.
